questions.text: Is this primarily a structural issue — roles, accountability, decision-making processes — or a behavioural and cultural issue around how people lead and act?
Who is primarily involved — the owner, a board or group of directors, the shareholder group, or the management team?
Is this situation urgent and needs addressing now, or is this a planned improvement?

label: strategy and planning
keywords: strategy|strategic planning|business plan|growth plan|long[- ]?term (plan|strategy|goal|objective|vision)|vision|mission|goals|objectives|direction|pivot|restructure|business model

questions.text: What's prompted this conversation — a growth opportunity, a performance challenge, a change in the business model, or are they doing structured planning for the first time?
Does the business currently have a documented strategic plan they actively work from?
What planning horizon makes sense here — 12 months, 2–3 years, or 5 years plus?

label: systems
keywords: \bsystems\b|processes|workflows|automation|\btechnology\b|\bsoftware\b|\bCRM\b|\bERP\b|operational efficiency|infrastructure|inefficiency|bottleneck

questions.text: What area of the business is the systems issue in — financial administration, operational workflow, technology and software, or HR and people systems?
Is this being driven by the business growing beyond its current systems, existing systems breaking down, or a desire to modernise?
Has the business attempted to address this before, and if so, what happened?

label: valuation
keywords: valuation|value the business|business worth|what is it worth|enterprise value|EBITDA|business value|how much is it worth|price the business|sale price

questions.text: What's the purpose of the valuation — potential sale, succession planning, a shareholder situation, raising finance, or benchmarking where they stand?
What's the likely timeframe — is this immediate, within 12 months, or longer-term planning?
Does the owner have a realistic sense of what the business is worth, or is establishing that part of what needs to happen first?

label: risk management
keywords: risk management|risk exposure|liability|business risk|contingency|disaster recovery|business continuity|mitigate risk|downside risk|key person|key man

questions.text: What type of risk are we dealing with — operational, financial, key person dependency, legal or compliance, reputational, or something else?
Is the client already aware of this risk, or is it something you've identified that they haven't fully appreciated yet?
How urgent is this — does it need immediate action, or is this a monitoring and planning conversation?

label: succession planning
keywords: succession|exit plan|retire|retiring|handover|next generation|family business|ownership transfer|management buyout|sell the business|exit strategy|ownership transition

questions.text: What's the most likely succession scenario — passing to family, a management buyout, an external sale, or are they still working through the options?
What's the timeframe — 1–2 years, 3–5 years, longer term, or is there a specific event or deadline driving it?
How emotionally ready does the owner seem to be — are they ready to go, actively working toward it, or is there still significant reluctance to let go?

label: conflict and conflict meetings
keywords: conflict|dispute|disagreement|tension|falling out|relationship breakdown|mediation|partnership dispute|directors fighting|ownership dispute|irreconcilable

questions.text: Who are the parties involved — business partners, co-directors, shareholders, family members in the business, or an employer-employee situation?
Where is the conflict at — early tension that's still manageable, an active dispute, or has it escalated to the point where legal proceedings are a real possibility?
In your view, does this situation need a legal or HR specialist involved first, or is this an advisory and mediation conversation?

label: end of year meetings
keywords: end of year|year end|annual review|year.end meeting|\bEOY\b|financial year end|tax year|annual planning|end.of.year

questions.text: What's the primary focus of this end of year meeting — reviewing the year's performance, setting goals and planning ahead, tax and financial planning, or a broader strategic conversation?
Is there a specific issue or opportunity you want to make sure gets addressed in this meeting, beyond the standard review?
How engaged is this client — do they actively participate and want depth, or is this more of a compliance-focused relationship where they want the key points only?

label: due diligence
keywords: due diligence|acquisition|acquire|merger|buying a business|purchase a business|buying the business|DD report|information memorandum

questions.text: What's the situation — are they acquiring a business, being approached for acquisition, entering a new partnership or joint venture, or making an investment decision?
What's your role in this process — are you leading the due diligence, supporting alongside other advisors, or providing advisory commentary on the findings?
What's the timeline — is there a deadline driving this, or is it still at the exploratory stage?
